message:
fix(api): mount the search function under /api/v1 and document it

- Vercel mounts api/<file> at /api/<file>, so the function has to live in
  api/v1/ to answer at /api/v1/search
- added the search endpoint to the discovery document, the OpenAPI spec and the
  docs page
- OpenAPI parameters were all marked in:path and required, which is wrong for
  query parameters; path params are now distinguished from query params
- category slugs are English now (vouchers, cub-skins) since the API is
  English-first and categories have no pages of their own
- fixed the stale category example URL in the docs
author: BSS Index Developer
